source.title: 13. Older Adults: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom model has no guideline_recommendation atom kind. Recommendation statements use author_conclusion with guideline_recommendation and source-grade tags.

The quantitative-result model is oriented toward primary-study effect structures. Secondary study summaries, prevalence figures, thresholds, and ranges that do not map cleanly to one population-exposure-outcome-effect object remain other atoms with secondary_reported_result or topic tags rather than being forced into quantitative_result.
extraction_limitations: This Standards chapter is a clinical practice guideline section, not a primary study. Study findings summarized in the chapter remain secondary reports anchored to dc26s013.pdf.
The chapter delegates the full ADA evidence-grading method and committee methodology to the separate Introduction and Methodology, which was not part of this source packet.
The 194 bibliography entries were extracted to the reference task queue and were not atomized.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human reviewer step is represented.
No external web verification was performed. The run is grounded in the exact Drive PDF and project sources.
